events.continuity_hook: First active itinerary; establishes the Raleigh seminar as the initial planning file.
events.interaction_goal: Build a practical flight-and-hotel shortlist around the teaching schedule, with clear open questions for the host.
events.scenario_brief: Kara is setting up a February pediatric gait seminar at a therapy practice in the Raleigh area, with Friday afternoon setup, a full Saturday course, and a possible Sunday lab. She must leave Tampa after a Thursday morning class, stay within a practical drive of the host clinic, and avoid a return that leaves her wiped out for Monday teaching; the Sunday lab end time and the host-approved hotel radius are still unresolved.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Raleigh plan after host details remove most of the return-day uncertainty.
events.interaction_goal: Narrow the hotel choice and pair it with a return flight that leaves enough time after the Sunday lab.
events.scenario_brief: The host sends the exact clinic address near Cary and confirms the Sunday lab will end by 12:15 p.m. Return flights can now focus on Sunday afternoon, while the hotel comparison has a trade-off: the closest reliable properties cover the room basics but lack a hot tub, and a farther option has the fuller recovery setup. The remaining decision is whether proximity or post-teaching recovery matters more for this weekend.

events.continuity_hook: Closes the Raleigh seminar planning unless an airline schedule change or hotel issue appears before travel.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flight and hotel booking, request a window seat, and note any details Kara should verify in the confirmation emails.
events.scenario_brief: Kara is ready to commit after the host confirms reimbursement and Friday check-in timing. The chosen hotel still has a queen room with coffee maker and mini-fridge available, but the nonstop outbound has become expensive; a one-stop outbound plus an afternoon return still fits the schedule. Seat selection needs to be handled during booking if available.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a separate clinic-training trip after the Raleigh seminar bookings are settled.
events.interaction_goal: Compare realistic Monday outbound and Wednesday return options, then shortlist hotels by commute reliability and room basics.
events.scenario_brief: A Milwaukee clinic asks Kara to run a Tuesday-Wednesday hands-on staff training in late March. She can leave Tampa on Monday after 1:00 p.m., needs to be onsite by 7:30 a.m. Tuesday, and wants to return after Wednesday’s final debrief without cutting the airport transfer too close. The unresolved hotel choice is between an older clinic-adjacent property and a more dependable airport-area chain.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Milwaukee trip after the schedule change makes the earlier return plan too tight.
events.interaction_goal: Determine whether the existing return can be kept safely, and if not, identify the least disruptive replacement.
events.scenario_brief: The Milwaukee clinic moves the Wednesday debrief from early afternoon to 3:00 p.m. and asks Kara to bring demo equipment back instead of shipping it. The earlier return no longer has enough cushion for packing, traffic, and bag check. She needs a quick decision between a later Wednesday flight and adding one night for a Thursday morning return.

events.continuity_hook: Begins a longer-horizon conference planning episode after the Milwaukee adjustment, with no flights committed yet.
events.interaction_goal: Compare conference-block and nearby hotel options, flag room and recovery-amenity gaps, and decide whether to hold a refundable room while waiting on the presentation schedule.
events.scenario_brief: Registration opens for a June pediatric rehab conference in Denver, and the association releases its hotel block earlier than expected. Kara may present a Friday breakout but the program slot is not final, so flights should stay tentative while lodging is compared. The official hotels have mixed ratings and uneven room amenities, making the main unresolved choice a refundable block reservation versus a better-rated nearby hotel.
